card.name: Words just before a drug-class term
card.fires_on: Short words or word starts (a, to, required, R, pro, and) sitting just before a drug-class or therapy name in label warnings and interaction text. The next word is usually a drug name or class such as RAS inhibitors, belatacept or progestin.

modes.label: Small word before therapy name
modes.description: A short linking word like a, to or on comes right before a named drug or regimen.
